Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire. Helpful context. Quick answers below and then Ill set up a short call with our infra lead to go through the spreadsheet: 

1) Log retention: For Redwood Private (dedicated/VPC deployments) we can support configurable retention windows beyond 90 days. We maintain the same audit pipeline and can expose retention settings; well have our infra engineer confirm limits during the call.
2) KMS: Customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments. Keys are managed in the customers KMS (we have integrations documented here: https://redwood.ai/docs/kms-integration). Key rotation is initiated by the customer; we support both scheduled and manual rotation flows.

Proposed times for a 30-minute technical sync (PST): 
- Thu 4/8 10:00–10:30
- Thu 4/8 15:00–15:30
- Fri 4/9 08:30–09:00

If one of those works Ill send a calendar invite and include our infra lead and product security. If you prefer a written response to the full spreadsheet before a call, we can prioritize the most critical fields first and loop Legal where needed.

Thanks again — aiming to keep this lightweight so procurement can finalize timeline.
